apply.title: Apply for the 8-Week Pilates Program | Move with Diana
apply.description: Answer a few short questions to see if the 8-Week Pilates Program is right for your body. It takes about 2 minutes. No payment needed to apply.

notYet.title: Thank you for applying | Move with Diana
notYet.description: Thank you for your application. Here is the best next step for you and your body.

blocks.question: Do any of these apply to you right now?
blocks.help: Click all that apply. A serious condition could be a heart condition, osteoporosis, a recent fracture, or a nerve or disc issue.
blocks.requiredMessage: Click any that apply, or choose No medical conditions.

blocks.question: Has a doctor or physical therapist cleared you for exercise?

body: Because you don't have a clear OK for exercise yet, the right next step is a conversation with your doctor or physical therapist before we start working together.

next.title: Talk to your doctor or PT

next.title: Message me when you have the OK
